description: Dark rounded purple button that glows on hover.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Big Crab 49</title>
<style>
/* Big Crab 49 by TimTrayler — https://uiverse.io/TimTrayler/big-crab-49 */
button {
 --hover-shadows: 16px 16px 33px #121212,
                   -16px -16px 33px #303030;
 --accent: fuchsia;
 font-weight: bold;
 letter-spacing: 0.1em;
 border: none;
 border-radius: 1.1em;
 background-color: #212121;
 color: white;
 padding: 1em 2em;
 transition: box-shadow ease-in-out 0.3s,
             background-color ease-in-out 0.1s,
             letter-spacing ease-in-out 0.1s,
             transform ease-in-out 0.1s;
 box-shadow: 13px 13px 10px #1c1c1c,
             -13px -13px 10px #262626;
}

button:hover {
 box-shadow: var(--hover-shadows);
}

button:active {
 box-shadow: var(--hover-shadows),
              var(--accent) 0px 0px 30px 5px;
 background-color: var(--accent);
 transform: scale(0.95);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Click me
</button>

</body>
</html>
